purpose: Make the existing in-sample golden-cross result fully reproducible and define what genuinely new evidence must come next. NOT a proof of edge.
disclaimer: This is an IN-SAMPLE, PARAMETER-SELECTED, SURVIVORSHIP-BIASED result. No holdout, no out-of-sample, no forward evidence. Nothing here is proven/validated/executable.
note_on_commit: The base tree was dirty (uncommitted). The additive --emit-trades change + these freeze artifacts are committed on top; see the commit that adds docs/research/gc-truth-freeze.

golden_cross_backtest.mjs.note: The --emit-trades change is READ-ONLY: both SHAs produce byte-identical headline stats (median +1.1% gross / win 54% / n=134).

documented_command_was_BROKEN.bug: omits --max; MAX defaults to 211, so it runs only the first 211 symbols of the ~2874-coin universe

frozen_hypothesis.instrument_intended: eligible real crypto spot assets only
frozen_hypothesis.entry: fresh daily SMA50 crossing above SMA200, AND cross-day volume >= 3x its 50-day average, AND cross-day quote turnover >= $1,000,000
frozen_hypothesis.exit: 15% trailing stop (ratchets on intraday highs, triggers on intraday lows); death-cross / series-end as backstops

data.source_venues: multi = union of Binance + Gate + MEXC USDT spot pairs, deduped by base asset with priority Binance>Gate>MEXC
data.usable_symbols_with_200d_history: ~2253 (varies with feed; 2529 raw crosses detected, 134 passed the frozen filters)
data.venue_provenance_GAP: Per-symbol source venue was NOT persisted at fetch time. It is re-derived by multiUniverse() at run time from CURRENT exchange listings, which may differ from the 2026-07-23 fetch. Leave-one-venue-out uses this re-derived mapping. Trade log venue mix: binance 82, gate 50, mexc 2.

instrument_rules.NOT_excluded_MISMATCH: Leveraged tokens (e.g. BTC3S, PEPE3L, DOGE5L) and tokenized equities (e.g. AMZNON) were NOT excluded. This VIOLATES the frozen 'real spot only' intent. 9 such instruments appear in the 134 trades; a real-spot-only diagnostic is in robustness.txt.
instrument_rules.production_divergence: Production scanner is Gate-only with ZERO exclusions (admits leveraged + tokenized). Backtest is multi-venue with the stable/wrapped exclusion above. Backtest and production instrument sets DIFFER.

fees_and_fills.slippage_model: NONE (no slippage, no order-book depth, no market impact)
fees_and_fills.capacity_model: NONE ($1M turnover floor is a liquidity proxy, not depth)
fees_and_fills.fill_model: daily OHLC; trailing high-water mark ratchets on daily highs, stop triggers on daily lows; conservative intrabar ordering (stops checked before take-profit). LIVE production only sees 30s snapshots -> a known backtest-vs-live parity gap.

parameter_variants_already_tried_MULTIPL.note: The frozen config (vol3x / $1M / trail15 / wait90 / 50-200) was SELECTED as best-looking from a large in-sample search. No multiple-testing correction was applied.

headline_result.median_net_95pct_CI_bootstrap: [-1.49%, +4.48%] (straddles zero; ignores date-clustering so true CI is wider)

known_biases_and_mismatches: SURVIVORSHIP: universe = coins listed today; dead/delisted coins that crossed then died are absent (optimistic).
MULTIPLE TESTING: many param combos tried, best selected, no correction; frozen config is not even the best in-sample (vol2x/trail10 = +4.0%/65%).
NO HOLDOUT / NO OUT-OF-SAMPLE: all discovery and selection on the same data.
OUTLIER CONCENTRATION: ~66% of total summed return comes from 10 of 134 trades; removing them makes the median negative.
NON-INDEPENDENCE: 134 trades on only 92 distinct entry dates (one date has 8 simultaneous entries); crypto is highly cross-correlated, so effective sample << 134.
VENUE HETEROGENEITY: Binance-sourced trades are net-negative; the entire positive result comes from Gate-sourced trades.
CROSS-VENUE VOLUME: 50-day average and 24h volume can come from different venues; not normalized/tested (and production is Gate-only).
INSTRUMENT CONTRACT: backtest admits leveraged/tokenized-equity; production admits even more; no enforced 'real spot only' contract.
BACKTEST-vs-LIVE PARITY: backtest uses daily OHLC extremes for the trail; production ratchets only from 30s snapshots -> spikes between refreshes are missed live.
DAILY SETTLEMENT (live): production startDailyRoll records the first post-midnight snapshot as the settled bar (wrong).
NET vs GROSS: the headline +1.1% is GROSS; net of the 0.4% assumed round-trip is +0.69% median; no slippage/impact modeled.
classification_reasoning: Positive point estimate but net median +0.69% with 95% CI straddling zero; entirely dependent on a handful of outlier trades (remove top 10 of 134 -> negative median), one venue (Binance subset negative), and an extreme-volume subset (>=10x bucket carries it); one chronological fold strongly negative (29% win); knife-edge parameter sensitivity (trail 15->20 flips sign). Net win rate 52% is below the 55% kill threshold. Not REJECTED because the mechanism is plausible and day-level/high-volume signals are suggestive; not a clean FORWARD-TEST CANDIDATE without the caveats above.
only_acceptable_future_confirmation: Genuinely unseen FORWARD data collected strictly AFTER this freeze timestamp (paper trades from the live flywheel, dated after 2026-07-27), OR

A clearly independent dataset never examined during this parameter search (e.g., a different exchange universe or a pre-2023 history window never used here) — evaluated ONCE at the frozen config with no re-tuning.
